Sentence (English): I purchased this without doing much research as my 19 year old Bosch finally quit after years of trouble-free service.
Comments (English): [ it works, but has several flaws.  ] || ---------------- || I purchased this without doing much research as my 19 year old Bosch finally quit after years of trouble-free service. First issue : when you order a dishwasher, there is a delivery appointment, and a separate installation appointment. When I checked out from Costco.com, it said that my delivery appointment and installation appointment were on the same day. GREAT! The day before the appointments, the delivery was confirmed for early morning. Later that evening I received a call from the installer that the first appointment was 1 week later. Ultimately I ended up installing on my own, as I didn't want to wait another week without a dishwasher. First impressions : this new KitchenAid just feels cheap. When you slide the racks in and out, it feels cheap. The arrangement of the metal tines in a rack is very basic, and doesn't hold things in place (for example, the plates tip over and do a domino effect when pulling the rack in or out, unless you are really careful to do it very slowly). During installation, I was shocked by how everything underneath the machine is seemingly cheap plastic and has wiring running all over the place. The Bosch that i took out didn't look anything like this. The third rack is an interesting feature, but it so shallow that not much actually fits up there. I also quickly noticed that there is not any indication of how long the cycles will take. Not a big deal as we usually run the dishwasher overnight . but was a feature I didn't realize that I would miss, and I was surprised that this machine didn't have. This dishwasher is SIGNIFICANTLY louder than my 19 year old Bosch. but OK, I can deal with that, but I figured that a KitchenAid machine in 2025 would be able to compete with Bosch from the turn of the century. The part that is really making me mad is that the dryer vent, on the top left of the door (you can see it in pictures), has a seemingly terrible design flaw. While I was initially excited about this feature (because the steam can escape during the drying phase and result in "dry" dishes), I quickly found a huge issue. While the dishes do seem dryer than what my previous machine would do, when you open the dishwasher to empty it, water leaks out of that vent, leaving a puddle on the ground. Sometimes it is 1oz of water. So, it results in a wet floor, wet socks, eventually will damage the hardwood floor after daily exposure. I was just doing some research in attempt to fix this, but it seems that this is a common issue with no solution. People online talk about multiple service visits with no fix. I don't have time for that. I will either block off the vent completely with silicone, or return this back to Costco if it bothers me enough. Do some research on this issue and you will see what I mean. Otherwise, it is a dishwasher, it washes dishes. Based on build quality, I will be shocked if it lasts 5 years. Time will tell.

Sentence (English): Overall this dishwasher is a very nice upgrade to the previous Bosch model that I owned for the last 14 years.
Comments (English): [ Good with some caveats ] || ---------------- || Overall this dishwasher is a very nice upgrade to the previous Bosch model that I owned for the last 14 years. It is definitely quieter and I really like the third drawer at the top that primarily is for silverware. My only concern, if not a complaint, is that some of the dishwasher functionality is only accessible in the app. I am not a fan of appliances having things like Wi-Fi and "smarts" that require an app to use them. There really should be no reason why anyone needs an app to use their dishwasher and I should certainly not have to create an account and open an app just to use some of the functionality of the product that I bought. If it's a feature it should be available on the device itself. That said, I do like the feature that opens the dishwasher a little bit after the cycle is done to allow venting of moisture and better drying of the dishes. So overall I think the performance is great but I really don't see the benefit in all the added "smart" features, and I dislike that I had to create an account and download an app just to configure all the settings on the machine.

Sentence (English): We replaced a 20 yr.
Comments (English): We replaced a 20 yr. old Whirlpool. It still worked okay, but silverware tray latch was broken (and small), a couple of the rack posts rusted and broken, and it was fairly loud. It's amazing how newer models have SO much more space, yet the same outer dimensions. They've really shrunk the pump/mechanical compartment at bottom. Plenty of space, so we added another silverware tray on the bottom. The upper shelf is great for spatulas, lids, and things like that. Haven't had a need to use it, but it's nice that middle shelf has adjustable height. I like that you can delay start, so you don't forget to turn it on before going to bed. And this model is SUPER quiet. Wife is impressed how well it cleans things like pet food bowls, with no need to "pre-clean." It dries very well, too. A couple of things to get used to: It takes more force to open and close, but that prevents it from slamming open if you let go of the door, and lets you stop it at any position. And that lower tray will roll back in really fast & slam into the back if you let it. Manual is pretty useless- no real info on features, it's really more of an installation guide. Installation was on time, and they were friendly. But it is mounted slightly off-center in the opening. Most wouldn't notice, but I may reset it. Over all, very pleased, and wife is happy.

Sentence (English): We bought the GE dishwasher after our service repairman suggested we use Costco to buy our next dishwasher.
Comments (English): We bought the GE dishwasher after our service repairman suggested we use Costco to buy our next dishwasher. He said the price they list includes installation and take away of old appliance. He also said the extra year warranty wasn't offered anywhere else. We decided in GE because we were replacing a 4 year old high end LG dishwasher (will never buy LG again). All our other appliances have been GE and have had no major issues. We were a little concerned about installation since most of the horrible reviews centered around this. I spoke to a Costco employee at our local store and she said people don't read the instructions when ordering dishwashers online and the requirements needed in order for installation. We read through everything and it all seemed good. It was a little confusing because a notice came up that we would need to make a separate appointment for installation once the dishwasher was delivered. We selected the date we wanted the dishwasher delivered for a week later. We then received a message that not only would the dishwasher be delivered that day but installation would also happen that day. It said we would be contacted the night before on the time of delivery and installation. We were fully prepared to make an installation appointment and wait longer if needed. We were contacted the evening before and given a 2 hour window for delivery and installation. He said the price they list includes installation and take away of old appliance. He also said the extra year warranty wasn't offered anywhere else. We decided in GE because we were replacing a 4 year old high end LG dishwasher (will never buy LG again). All our other appliances have been GE and have had no major issues. We were a little concerned about installation since most of the horrible reviews centered around this. I spoke to a Costco employee at our local store and she said people don't read the instructions when ordering dishwashers online and the requirements needed in order for installation. We read through everything and it all seemed good. It was a little confusing because a notice came up that we would need to make a separate appointment for installation once the dishwasher was delivered. We selected the date we wanted the dishwasher delivered for a week later. We then received a message that not only would the dishwasher be delivered that day but installation would also happen that day. It said we would be contacted the night before on the time of delivery and installation. We were fully prepared to make an installation appointment and wait longer if needed. We were contacted the evening before and given a 2 hour window for delivery and installation. The person on the phone assured us they would be installing the dishwasher that day and no need to make another appointment. The serviceman arrived during the time window stated, installed the dishwasher and answered any questions we had. Robert did a great job making sure everything worked and was installed properly. This dishwasher is slightly louder than our previous higher end LG dishwasher. However it had a lot of other great features that our other didn't have. The Boost Drying feature actually does dry the dishes. We also love how deep the top rack is to put tall cups like 40 oz Hydroflask cups. The design of this dishwasher allows me to put in more dishes. It also does better at cleaning the dishes. I have never had to go back and rewash anything be side it didn't get it clean the first time. We have been very impressed by the quality of the product, the warranty offered by Costco, and the installation (and communication about the installation). We have been so impressed through this whole process that any future appliances will be bought through Costco.

Sentence (English): Bought my first Bosch after many dishwasher disappointments.
Comments (English): [ Solid Quiet and Clean ] || ---------------- || Bought my first Bosch after many dishwasher disappointments. Installation was easy and quick. The unit is solid in its construction and thoughtfulness. Even though there are quieter dishwashers out there, we can still only hear minimal noise and rely upon the smart red light to tell us it's running through a cycle. In terms of the construction I question the integrity of the wash arm clips as a weak point. The dishwasher does a great job cleaning the dishes but a small amount of moisture remains on some of the upper rack mugs. Lastly, although I love the purpose of the third rack, if your placing much beyond a spatula, caution must be taken to avoid binding, while lowering the adjustable third rack also limits placing glasses underneath it. That said it's a wonderful addition to our kitchen, a superior product, and we hope to have it for many years to come.

The top rack is quite deep and is useful for coffee cups, shallow bowls, and cooking utensils. That rack does take away a little space from the middle rack, such that I can no longer put salad plates vertically in there. Thus, most of my plates must go on the bottom rack.One minor quibble: the silverware holder has various sized slots for utensils. My main flatware won't fit through its narrower slots. Admittedly, I rarely have a LOT of flatware to wash, but that's a drawback.One important point however: while shopping around for this dishwasher, we noticed that one store had the older model (which we bought) and the other store had the "new model." Sentence (English): We replaced this unit with a 20-year old whirlpool dishwasher, which was top of the line at the time and rated as "whisper quiet" or something to that effect.
Comments (English): [ Stainless steel tub with an all-plastic frame ] || ---------------- || We replaced this unit with a 20-year old whirlpool dishwasher, which was top of the line at the time and rated as "whisper quiet" or something to that effect. We could hear the hum upstairs in the bedroom. You can barely hear this one when it is running. I have an issue though with the positioning of the drain outlet. The elbow on the hose can only be attached at 90 degrees left or the right of the machine, which is ok if you have a side exit in your cabinet. If your drain needs to exit towards the back, the semi-rigid hose has to form a “S” curve as you push the machine into the cabinet, which likely puts strain on both the plastic drain outlet and the hose. This also causes the machine to end up at a slight angle instead of being flush in the front because the hose bunches up in the back. There is presumably a test cycle that can be run after installation, but the instructions are generic and not specific for this model. There are certainly some improvements in functionality versus my 20-year old unit, but for the most part it has an all-plastic frame and connections, that feel cheap.

Sentence (English): It's perfect!
Comments (English): [ Highly recommended for small households ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Reason for purchase: I don't usually cook, so I don't have a lot of dishes to wash, so I didn't really need a dishwasher. Even though people raved about how convenient it was, I always did it by hand, so I didn't really need one. But when I started feeding my baby solids, the dishes piled up, and I didn't have time to do them. ^^ I was feeling the need for a dishwasher, so I saw it on the Coupang Experience Group and signed up! Pros: First of all, the compact size is fantastic! With fewer people in each household these days, larger appliances can be a bit overwhelming, especially considering their size. This one is perfect for a family of three! It's the perfect size. It has just the right features, no unnecessary ones, and it's super easy to use! My biggest concern with new appliances is how much space they take up, but this one is the perfect size to place next to the sink, which is a real plus. And the biggest advantage is that I could install it myself, without any drilling or draining required! Even if I did it myself, drilling a sink was a big job and a bit burdensome, but this product is really convenient because I just have to let the drain hose fall into the sink. It was really amazing that I could just pour water in it without having to install a separate water tank. It even feels like it saves water compared to washing dishes normally. Above all, it looks really pretty from an interior perspective. I usually use a Minix food waste disposer, and when I put it next to me, it looks neat and pretty. And an automatic door opening function is essential for a dishwasher, and this product has all the necessary functions in a small package, so the automatic door opening function is very convenient. (The door opens and closes automatically after washing!) And after washing, it automatically goes into safe storage mode for 24 hours, so I can store the dishes without having to put them away separately, which is even better! It dries them with hot air after washing, so there are no water marks on the dishes, and it looks neat and clean. Cons: When I first used it, after washing and putting it in drying mode, it smelled like burnt plastic? But since it's something that happens when you use new electronic products, I can't really say it's a disadvantage. And it says to use a special detergent, but we have a special detergent for baby bottles that we've been using, so we just use that. I think it would be better to use a special detergent, right? I haven't had any problems with anything not cleaning so far! Tip: I use the special dishwasher that I bought before for baby bottles, but if you haven't bought a separate dishwasher, you can buy a separate bottle tray to wash baby bottles, so keep that in mind! Overall Review: This dishwasher is perfect for a single person or a household with 2-3 people! The exterior is so clean and pretty, and it blends in well without ruining the interior, which is really nice. Even though it's small, it has all the necessary functions and cleans very well! Above all, it's very easy to install and easy to use, so I highly recommend it to anyone who's lazy. It's perfect!

Sentence (English): I replaced my 17 yr old Frigidaire dishwasher with this Bosch 500 series dishwasher because the touch pad control panel on my old dishwasher stopped working.
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I replaced my 17 yr old Frigidaire dishwasher with this Bosch 500 series dishwasher because the touch pad control panel on my old dishwasher stopped working. I was skeptical at first about because of the some of the negative comments I read here, but after using my new Bosch dishwasher, I'm very pleased and happy with the result.Some people are complaining that it leaks from behind the washer but I find that hard to believe to be true, not unless the installation is wrong or water inlet hose and elbow connectors was overtightened and damaged the fittings. The water inlet port also has a built-in dirt filter which should NOT be removed. Maybe some installer removed it thinking it was a cover, which obviously will damage the water inlet and will cause a leak.Some people also complained about the dishes are not dry after the cleaning cycle. I wonder if they are not reading the instructions because the Auto-Air drying feature works very well! It opens the front door automatically after the cleaning cycle to let steam out and lets the natural drying process do its work, making it dry very efficient without using additional electrical power when drying dishes. The only thing I did not really like is the use of plastic water inlet connectors which might easily break if you don't follow directions to not overtighten the hose connectors. Another complain that I have is the door feels flimsy and weak, like it flexes quite a bit and the door handle feels cheap and flimsy too that it sometimes makes a cracking sound when you open the door. Overall I find it to be a good dishwasher, I like that it is so easy to adjust the height of the middle rack. The top rack is awesome and can hold lots of spoon and forks, cutlery and some cooking utensils. I have to give only 4 stars because of my complaint about the door feeling flimsy and weak. Hopefully this lasts as long as my previous dishwasher

It's a product I'm very satisfied with in terms of design, cleaning power, capacity, and noise. It saves me the time I spent bending over and washing dishes by hand, giving me a lot more freedom. It's a bit pricey, but I've found it to be well worth the price, and I'm confident I'll be using it for a long time.
Comments (Original): [ 식세기 신세계네요~~ ] || ---------------- || 주방 일을 덜어주는 최고의 가전이 바로 식기세척기라고 생각해서, 드디어 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기를 들였어요. 14인용 대용량 모델이라 가족이 많은 집에서도 여유롭게 사용할 수 있고, 디자인까지 고급스러워서 설치하고 나니 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌습니다.  아이보리 톤의 심플하고 세련된 외관은 오브제컬렉션 특유의 감성이 잘 담겨 있어요. 주방 가구와 조화를 이루면서도 깔끔하게 어울리고, 빌트인이라 공간 활용도 좋습니다. 버튼부는 직관적이고 깔끔해서 처음 사용하는 사람도 어렵지 않게 조작할 수 있었어요.  식기세척기를 고를 때 가장 중요한 건 세척력인데, 역시 LG답게 기대 이상이었어요. 기름기 많은 프라이팬이나 접시도 말끔하게 세척되고 컵, 유리잔 같은 섬세한 식기도 깨끗하게 관리돼요. 특히 고온세척과 다양한 프로그램(일반, 강력, 에코 등)이 있어서 상황에 따라 맞춤 세척이 가능해요. 세척 후에는 건조 기능까지 확실히 되어 바로 꺼내 사용해도 물자국이 거의 남지 않았습니다.  14인용이라 넉넉한 공간이 가장 큰 장점이에요. 한 번에 많은 양의 식기를 넣을 수 있어 매 끼니마다 돌리지 않아도 되고, 수저나 조리도구 전용 공간도 있어 정리하기 편리했어요. 내부 선반은 높낮이 조절이 가능해 큰 냄비나 접시도 문제없이 넣을 수 있었어요.  작동할 때 소음이 크지 않아 밤에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있었고, 에너지 효율도 좋아 전기요금 걱정이 덜했어요. 특히 에코 모드를 자주 사용하면 전력 소모가 적어 경제적이더라고요.  가족이 많아 한 번에 많은 식기를 세척해야 하는 분, 주방 인테리어와 어울리는 깔끔한 빌트인 식기세척기를 찾는 분, 세척력, 건조력, 소음까지 신경 쓰는 분께 추천합니다!!!  디자인, 세척력, 용량, 소음까지 모두 만족스러운 제품이에요. 매번 설거지로 허리 굽히고 손 설거지하던 시간을 아껴서 훨씬 여유로워졌습니다. 가격대는 있지만, 사용해보니 충분히 값어치를 하는 제품이라 오래도록 만족하며 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Stainless steel tub with an all-plastic frame ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) We replaced this unit with a 20-year old whirlpool dishwasher, which was top of the line at the time and rated as "whisper quiet" or something to that effect. We could hear the hum upstairs in the bedroom. You can barely hear this one when it is running. I have an issue though with the positioning of the drain outlet. The elbow on the hose can only be attached at 90 degrees left or the right of the machine, which is ok if you have a side exit in your cabinet. If your drain needs to exit towards the back, the semi-rigid hose has to form a “S” curve as you push the machine into the cabinet, which likely puts strain on both the plastic drain outlet and the hose. This also causes the machine to end up at a slight angle instead of being flush in the front because the hose bunches up in the back. There is presumably a test cycle that can be run after installation, but the instructions are generic and not specific for this model. There are certainly some improvements in functionality versus my 20-year old unit, but for the most part it has an all-plastic frame and connections, that feel cheap.

Sentence (English): I've always believed that a dishwasher is the ultimate kitchen appliance, so I finally purchased the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It's a whole new world of dishwashing~~ ] || ---------------- || I've always believed that a dishwasher is the ultimate kitchen appliance, so I finally purchased the LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher. With its large capacity, it's perfect for a large family, and its luxurious design has completely transformed the kitchen atmosphere since installation. The simple, sophisticated ivory exterior perfectly captures the Objet Collection's signature sensibility. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen cabinets, and its built-in design makes for excellent space utilization. The intuitive and clean controls made it easy to use, even for first-time users. Cleaning power is the most important factor when choosing a dishwasher, and as expected from LG, it exceeded my expectations. It cleans greasy pans and plates thoroughly, and delicate items like cups and glasses are kept clean. The high-temperature wash and various programs (normal, heavy, and eco) allow for customized cleaning depending on the situation. The drying function also ensures that the dishwasher is completely dry, leaving virtually no water stains even when used immediately. The ample space for 14 people is a major advantage. It can hold a lot of dishes at once, so I don't have to rotate it for every meal, and there's even a dedicated space for cutlery and utensils, making it easy to organize. The internal shelves are height-adjustable, so I could easily fit large pots and plates. It's quiet during operation, so I can use it even at night without any worries, and its energy efficiency means less worry about my electricity bill. Frequent use of the Eco mode reduces power consumption, which is especially beneficial. I recommend this dishwasher to anyone with a large family who needs to wash a lot of dishes at once, anyone looking for a sleek built-in dishwasher that matches their kitchen decor, and anyone concerned about cleaning power, drying power, and even noise! It's a product I'm very satisfied with in terms of design, cleaning power, capacity, and noise. It saves me the time I spent bending over and washing dishes by hand, giving me a lot more freedom. It's a bit pricey, but I've found it to be well worth the price, and I'm confident I'll be using it for a long time.

Comments (Original): [ 식세기 신세계네요~~ ] || ---------------- || 주방 일을 덜어주는 최고의 가전이 바로 식기세척기라고 생각해서, 드디어 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 빌트인 식기세척기를 들였어요. 14인용 대용량 모델이라 가족이 많은 집에서도 여유롭게 사용할 수 있고, 디자인까지 고급스러워서 설치하고 나니 주방 분위기가 확 달라졌습니다.아이보리 톤의 심플하고 세련된 외관은 오브제컬렉션 특유의 감성이 잘 담겨 있어요. 주방 가구와 조화를 이루면서도 깔끔하게 어울리고, 빌트인이라 공간 활용도 좋습니다. 버튼부는 직관적이고 깔끔해서 처음 사용하는 사람도 어렵지 않게 조작할 수 있었어요.식기세척기를 고를 때 가장 중요한 건 세척력인데, 역시 LG답게 기대 이상이었어요.기름기 많은 프라이팬이나 접시도 말끔하게 세척되고컵, 유리잔 같은 섬세한 식기도 깨끗하게 관리돼요.특히 고온세척과 다양한 프로그램(일반, 강력, 에코 등)이 있어서 상황에 따라 맞춤 세척이 가능해요. 세척 후에는 건조 기능까지 확실히 되어 바로 꺼내 사용해도 물자국이 거의 남지 않았습니다.14인용이라 넉넉한 공간이 가장 큰 장점이에요. 한 번에 많은 양의 식기를 넣을 수 있어 매 끼니마다 돌리지 않아도 되고, 수저나 조리도구 전용 공간도 있어 정리하기 편리했어요. 내부 선반은 높낮이 조절이 가능해 큰 냄비나 접시도 문제없이 넣을 수 있었어요.작동할 때 소음이 크지 않아 밤에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있었고, 에너지 효율도 좋아 전기요금 걱정이 덜했어요. 특히 에코 모드를 자주 사용하면 전력 소모가 적어 경제적이더라고요.가족이 많아 한 번에 많은 식기를 세척해야 하는 분,주방 인테리어와 어울리는 깔끔한 빌트인 식기세척기를 찾는 분,세척력, 건조력, 소음까지 신경 쓰는 분께 추천합니다!!!디자인, 세척력, 용량, 소음까지 모두 만족스러운 제품이에요. 매번 설거지로 허리 굽히고 손 설거지하던 시간을 아껴서 훨씬 여유로워졌습니다. 가격대는 있지만, 사용해보니 충분히 값어치를 하는 제품이라 오래도록 만족하며 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.

Sentence (English): Believing that a dishwasher is the best appliance for easing kitchen chores, I finally got the LG DIOS Objet Collection built-in dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ The dishwasher is a whole new world! ] || ---------------- || Believing that a dishwasher is the best appliance for easing kitchen chores, I finally got the LG DIOS Objet Collection built-in dishwasher. As a large-capacity 14-place setting model, it allows for ample use even in a large family home, and its luxurious design completely transformed the kitchen atmosphere after installation. The simple yet sophisticated ivory-toned exterior perfectly captures the unique sensibility of the Objet Collection. It harmonizes neatly with kitchen furniture and, being a built-in unit, maximizes space utilization. The buttons are intuitive and clean, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. Cleaning performance is the most important factor when choosing a dishwasher, and true to LG's reputation, it exceeded my expectations. It cleans greasy frying pans and plates thoroughly, and keeps delicate tableware like cups and glasses spotless. In particular, the high-temperature wash and various programs (Normal, Powerful, Eco, etc.) allow for customized cleaning depending on the situation. The drying function after washing is also very effective, leaving almost no water stains even when used immediately. The spaciousness of the 14-place setting is its biggest advantage. I could load a large amount of dishes at once, so I didn't have to run it for every meal, and the dedicated space for cutlery and cooking utensils made organization convenient. The height of the interior shelves is adjustable, so I could fit large pots and plates without any problems. It operates quietly, so I could use it at night without any issues, and its energy efficiency meant I was less worried about electricity bills. In particular, using Eco mode frequently reduced power consumption, making it economical. I recommend this to those with large families who need to wash a lot of dishes at once, those looking for a sleek built-in dishwasher that matches their kitchen decor, and those who care about cleaning power, drying performance, and noise levels! It is a product that satisfies in terms of design, cleaning power, capacity, and noise. I have become much more relaxed by saving the time I used to spend bending over and hand-washing dishes every time. Although it is on the pricier side, after using it, I feel it is well worth the price, so I think I will be satisfied using it for a long time.

Comments (English): [ Small, but sufficient for a family of three. Improves quality of life! ] || ---------------- || Coupang Review of the Samsung 6-Place Beige Dishwasher. (High Satisfaction, Willing to Repurchase). Reason for Purchase. As I prepare three home-cooked meals a day while raising a child, washing dishes became a huge chore. Hand-washing would damage my hands, and the piles of small plates and cups were stressful. So, I looked for a 6-place dishwasher that wouldn't take up much space even in a small home, and I chose the Samsung 6-place Beige model because of its clean design and pretty color. Delivery & Installation. Coupang delivery was fast and safe. The beige color is actually more subtle in person than in the photos, so it matches the kitchen atmosphere well. Installation wasn't difficult; I was able to use it right away after connecting the hoses according to the instructions. You can request a professional installation, but it isn't too difficult to install it yourself. Cleaning Power & User Experience. I was surprised by how much cleaner it cleaned than I expected. Even greasy rice grains and soup bowls are wiped clean with just the right amount of detergent. Cups come out clear without any water stains, and plastic baby bottles were cleaned perfectly as well. In particular, since it washes at high temperature and dries the dishes afterwards, I feel reassured about hygiene. With a family of three, one cycle is sufficient to cover about two meals a day. Pros: Its compact size allows for easy installation even in small kitchens. As a 6-place setting, it is perfect for small homes and small families (2-3 people). The beige tone is luxurious and blends well with the interior. Both washing and drying performance exceeded expectations. It also saves water, making it more efficient than hand washing. Cons: Large pots or frying pans are too small to fit in at once, so it must be used primarily for small dishes. It does not dry completely to 100%, so plastic items may have slight water droplets after use. Initial installation can be a bit cumbersome if the space for connecting the hose is limited. Overall Review: Since it is Samsung, I can trust the after-sales service, and the beautiful design makes the kitchen feel like it has upgraded the atmosphere. The cleaning power is definitely satisfying, and the biggest advantage is being freed from the stress of doing dishes every day. A 6-place setting dishwasher is a truly efficient choice for small families or homes with children. I am satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio, design, and ease of maintenance. My quality of life has improved so much that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner.

Comments (English): [ You get what you pay for ] || ---------------- || My last dishwasher was a TOL Kitchenaid. It lasted 15 years, but the last year it became troublesome when holes appeared in the manifold that feeds water to the middle spray arm. It was repaired by us using shrink tubing to cover the holes. We saved our pennies and bought the very quiet 39db washer. It is certainly not TOL, more BOL. Do not like: the lower rack has no adjustable tines; the tines are spaced very far apart and plates topple over and smaller items run the risk of falling onto the sprayer arm below; the silverware holder when in place, leaves a big unusable space on each side or a gigantic unusable space if you shift the basket left or right (there should be a provided Utensil cup which fills the void); also, if you are not careful and do not lower the door completely when you try to pull out the lower rack, you could damage the heater element. Do like: it is very quiet; the upper utility tray; good selection of cycles.

Sentence (English): After much hesitation due to space constraints, I finally got it installed.
Comments (English): After much hesitation due to space constraints, I finally got it installed. It looks cleaner than when I washed the dishes myself, which is nice. I previously used a sterilizing dishwasher, and since it wouldn't turn off until the water was completely dry, I was worried it might be broken. I run it in the evening and clean it up in the morning, so it's not that inconvenient, so I was going to contact the manufacturer, but I decided to just use it. Even with the hot air cycle, the water doesn't dry completely enough to clean up immediately. If I want it to dry completely, I'll need a separate dryer. I'm grateful to the technician for providing detailed instructions, cleaning the entire unit, and sending me a good one. I've studied the controls a bit, so I'll use it properly. After about two weeks of use, overall, it's fine. The water is almost dry when I wake up after using the hot air cycle. I wipe off any remaining water droplets with a paper towel and clean up the dishes. I think I need about four or five small paper towel compartments. Overall, I'm satisfied with the product. I trust LG.

Then he said, "Do I have to use my annual leave next time to install it again?" and "I bought a strange item and used two days of my annual leave." He didn't even know if Monday was possible, so I asked for a refund, but that wasn't possible either. The customer service center said, "That's it." I asked them to do it as soon as possible, but they told me to contact them.

Comments (English): [ Highly recommend: trusted brand - solid choice ] || ---------------- || 1. Easy Installation. The installation process was straightforward thanks to the clear instructions provided in the manual. I was able to follow along without issues. However, for those who are not technically inclined, I highly recommend hiring a technician. They can ensure that both the water and electrical connections are handled safely. 2. Efficient Cleaning Performance. I tested multiple modes—including Sensor, Normal, and Quick Wash—under different load conditions (dishes, utensils, and pots). In every case, the results were impressive. The dishwasher consistently delivered clean, warm, and spotless dishes, regardless of the load size. 3. Noise Level. One of the standout features of this model is its quiet operation. I measured the sound level in a controlled, quiet environment, and it consistently averaged around 50 dB—about the same as a quiet room. This makes it much quieter than many other dishwashers and barely noticeable during operation. 4. Clear and Useful Guides. Whirlpool provides a wide range of documentation, including a Cycles Guide, Energy Guide, Installation Guide, Specifications, and a Use & Care Manual. These resources cover nearly everything I need to know to keep the dishwasher running efficiently over time. The diagrams are helpful, though I would prefer real, colored images instead of black-and-white drawings for better clarity. Additionally, the troubleshooting section—especially for error codes—could benefit from more detailed explanations. 5. Safety and Reliable Performance. During installation, I mistakenly left the cap on the garbage disposal's dishwasher drain connection. When I tested the Quick Wash cycle, after about 8 minutes the dishwasher detected the issue and triggered an F9E1 error code (“Dishwasher Will Not Drain”). Impressively, it stopped operation to prevent damage and water leakage. Although some water remained inside the tub, the unit's sealed design prevented any leaks outside. This gave me confidence in its safe and reliable performance. 6. AI Sensor Mode. This model features an AI-powered sensor mode designed to automatically adjust performance based on the load conditions (dishes, utensils, pots, etc.). To be honest, I did not notice a significant difference compared with the other modes. However, like the others, it consistently produced clean, warm, and spotless dishes. 7. Sani Rinse Option. The Sani Rinse option was one of the main reasons I chose this model, as I place high importance on reducing bacteria. I didn't research this feature extensively across other brands, but seeing it available on this model strongly influenced my decision to purchase. While it does extend the cycle time, the results are excellent and provide an added sense of safety and peace of mind. 8. Energy Efficiency. It's difficult for me to fully evaluate the energy efficiency at this point. There isn't a practical way to measure it directly, so I'll have to wait until I see my utility bill over time to determine the actual impact.

Sentence (English): Request for improvement of installation cost standards.
Comments (English): Request for improvement of installation cost standards. I recently moved into a new apartment and purchased an LG dishwasher. However, the installer didn't set a clear standard for the installation fee, making it difficult to trust the customer. In our case, even though our unit was 600mm wide, they charged us 180,000 won. I downloaded the "Dishwasher Installation Additional Cost Guide" from the LG Electronics website and asked the installer how they determined the 180,000 won fee. However, the installer said it was because LG didn't set the fee according to their own requirements. I don't understand what kind of rule-of-thumb costing this is. I want to pay according to LG's standard, so I request improvement.
Comments (Original): 설치 비용관련 기준 개선 요청금번에 신규 입주하는 아파트에 들어가면서 LG 식기세척기를 구독하였는데 설치시 설치기사님이 명확한 기준에의해 설치비용을 책정하는것이 아니어서 소비자 입장에서는 신뢰하기가 어렵습니다. 저희 경우는 W600mm규격장 임에도 불구하고 180,000원을 청구하였습니다. 제가 LG전자 홈페이지에 있는 '식기세척기 설치 추가 비용 안내'라는 기준표를 다운받아서 어떤기준으로 18만원이 책정되었는지를 설치기사님께 문의 하였으나 기사님께서는 LG가 자기들의 요구사항에 맞게 비용책정을 하지않아서 그런것이라고 말합니다. 이게 무슨 주먹구구식 비용책정인지 모르겠습니다. 저는 엘지에서 기준삼고 있는 비용대로 지급하고싶으니 이에대한 개선을 요구드립니다.

Sentence (English): After our KitchenAide dishwasher crapped out on us I reviewed CR's recommendations before deciding on what would be my next dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ BOSCH 2025 Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || After our KitchenAide dishwasher crapped out on us I reviewed CR's recommendations before deciding on what would be my next dishwasher. Based on their recommedations I chose the BOSCH 300 Series front control w/Home Connect and third tray option. I am sorry to say that I am disappointed in the unit for several reasons. The Home Connect is not as user friendly as I think it could be. Every once in a while I have to reboot my cell phone to get Home Connect to even come up. It doesn't tell you that in order to change any programming you may have been able to do, that in order to change the original you must make sure you have "turned on" your dw before in order to affect the changes. The unit itself is somewhat small to me on the inside and it doesn't dry well, especially plastic items. Finally, the "Clean" light on the front control panel only stays on for a few minutes after the cycle is complete instead of staying on until you open the unit to empty it. Because it acts this way, one does not know if the dishes inside have been cleaned or not. We ended up buying an outside magnet with slide to be able to indicate if the dishes are clean (washer has been run) or still dirty (washer not run yet). Otherwise the dishwasher does clean the dishes as it should.

Sentence (English): I've only had this dishwasher for a couple weeks, so reliability and longevity cannot be addressed.
Comments (English): [ Satisfied so far, but do your research. ] || ---------------- || I've only had this dishwasher for a couple weeks, so reliability and longevity cannot be addressed. I can say that the dishwasher is very quiet. I like the front control panel. All aspects of the dishwasher are attractive. There is a lot of room inside. Dishes are always clean and dried, except for plastic storage containers which usually need to be hand-dried no matter which dishwasher you are using. On the downside, on the bottom rack there is a large open area with no upright prongs. There are two sections with upright prongs, one for wide items and one for narrower items, but the space could be used much more efficiently if the middle open section also had upright prongs. Also, I haven't found a cycle yet that takes less than 3-1/2 hours to complete. Now just one more comment on the warranty. I didn't buy the extended warranty, so when I called (their on-line registration doesn't work) to register my appliance, they tried to sell me many versions of their extended warranty and explained that even though their one-year warranty covers parts and labor, it doesn't include the service call to determine what the problem is and that can cost $400 or more. Good to know, but to me this doesn't justify a monthly cost for the extended warranty. Makes me a little squeamish about whether or not I chose the right manufacturer, but time will tell, I guess.

I recently moved into a new apartment and purchased an LG dishwasher. I downloaded the "Guide to Additional Dishwasher Installation Costs" table from the LG Electronics website and asked the installer how they determined the 180,000 won fee. I want to pay according to LG's standard, so I request improvement.

Sentence (English): This is the quietest dishwasher I have ever owned.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher. so quiet! ] || ---------------- || This is the quietest dishwasher I have ever owned. My last GE dishwasher lasted 21 years. I hope the same for this one. I used the other one every day. One of my few complaints with this dishwasher is I find the space in the lower area to be smaller than my last dishwasher. Also the upper rack used to have a holder for stemware. While I appreciate the third rack that holds spatulas, etc. it would have still been good to include the stemware holder, in addition to the bottle sprays and make the space hold/capacity a little wider on that side. That way when you remove the third shelf to wash the wine glasses etc. you could still clip them in. I will see if the one from my old dishwasher will work in this dishwasher and repurpose. Finally, I liked the old dishwasher because if you opened the door to put something else in, when you closed it would automatically continue. This one you have to remember to push the start button after you close it.

Sentence (English): I previously used an LG dishwasher for 4 years, and I replaced it with a new one when I moved.
Comments (English): [ Let's take a close look. ] || ---------------- || I previously used an LG dishwasher for 4 years, and I replaced it with a new one when I moved. I bought it because I was attracted by the low price, and it is exactly what you'd expect for the price. The design is the same, but the door is a bit lighter, and the interior is two-tiered. There is no top tier to place scissors or cutlery on. Still, it cleans very well. It feels like an entry-level dishwasher. That doesn't mean it's bad, though, so please keep this in mind when making your purchase.

The bottom rack leaves a little more to be desired, it is missing more tines, etc, because Bosch adds extra rack features to the higher series. Comments (English): [ LG 24"Front Control Dishwasher customer evaluation ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher is ok but is going to take a little getting used to when compared to the GE unit that it replaced. Because it incorporates a handle flush with the front of the unit it doesn't have a handle to protect the front controls (or hang a dishtowel) and allows for the controls to be frequently activated when you just brush against it and is very annoying. The loading is odd and doesn't seem to have any place for glasses with recessed bottoms to be loaded on enough of an angle to drain and they will still have a little water left after drying unless the extended dry mode is selected. The unit while quiet is not as quiet as the GE dishwasher it replaced and especially in the water charge and discharge modes for some reason. So far I have no complaints about It getting the dishes clean but the full cleaning cycle is at least an hour longer when compared to the previous GE unit it replaced. Even if ok it we should have asked for the unit to be replaced however with all the added charges for installation we had already spent about twice as much as we originally anticipated.

Comments (English): [ Runs quiet ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher has pros and cons. Since we didn't use the top tray we removed it and that helps but I still wipe it out with a towel after unload the dishes. I would look into other models before purchasing this one again, but hopefully it lasts a long time and I won't have to worry about it.

Sentence (English): I was a little disappointed with the good reviews.
Comments (English): [ I was a little disappointed considering the good reviews. I expected it to be small, and once I got used to it, it wasn't a problem to load dishes, but I had to refill the water too often. If you use the quick mode once, you have to refill it. ] || ---------------- || I was a little disappointed with the good reviews. I expected the compact size, and once I got used to it, loading dishes wasn't a problem, but I had to refill the water too often. I had to refill it every time I used the quick mode, and I had to pour water three times from the 2000ml pitcher to fill it completely, which was annoying and made my hands hurt. I contacted Minix about drilling a hole to connect the water supply, but they said they couldn't send a technician. They said connecting the water supply line could result in a leak, so no one wanted to do it, even if I offered to pay a separate fee, such as a water purifier technician or a home repairman. It's a bit disappointing that the manufacturer has left the water supply to me to handle on my own. I wondered if they were trying to avoid responsibility for after-sales service. I'm also a little disappointed with the Minix-specific detergent. Dishes that were used for greasy, red foods, garlic, or other strongly scented foods, or silicone dishes that held side dishes for a long time, retain oiliness (even on high cycles, sometimes even when dishes weren't packed tightly), or a peculiar, musty smell lingers inside. I'm sensitive to odors, and even the cups had a fishy smell. I ended up buying a different detergent. Also, the standard and quick cycles never completely dry the dishes. Except for one or two, they all have water droplets. If you don't take them out and wipe them clean after washing, water stains will remain. Ultimately, I bought this for convenience, but it's just the mini-cycle that's inconvenient. Those who are sensitive to water stains or odors, or who cook frequently, may find it inconvenient. It takes too long, and to completely dry them, you have to press the dry button again after the basic cycle. That takes 3-4 hours. Unless you're home a lot, you'll probably find dishes with dried water stains or dripping water drops after work. This was the appliance I most looked forward to when I bought my newlywed home, but I'm disappointed in many ways.
